verdict.rationale: Zep documents a claimed sub-200ms retrieval latency target repeatedly (zep-docs-34, zep-docs-39, zep-docs-18), but this is a single marketing-style claim, not a documented benchmark with methodology, percentile breakdown, or measured p50/p95 numbers under varying load/graph size. missing for 10: p50/p95 breakdown, benchmark methodology/dataset details, independent or third-party measured latency verification, load/scale conditions tested.
